review.subtitle: Brushed steel case with crown guards, beige day-date dial, brown leather strap. Front relief GLB.
notes: Built on Hamilton's official 2000 px front render. House method: case, lugs, crown guards, bezel, crown and hands are modelled; the photo is used only for the dial print (numerals, day and date) and the leather strap.
The strap curls under at both ends, like the other tracker watches. The buckle is left out.
